text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the place I went out to with Almond Eye,
some kind of event seems to be underway.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, look!
'Walk-in challengers welcome!
Umamusume Tug-of-War Tournament!' it says!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
A showdown where Umamusume proud of their power gather, is it?
Perhaps I might take up the challenge?

text_block_list.name: Participant
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Allow me to teach you amateurs
the true art of tug-of-war...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Please take good care of me!

text_block_list.name: Participant
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaah!?!? ...Blegh! S-Sand got in my mouth...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Truly brushing aside all opposition—Almond Eye tore through the tug-of-war tournament with unstoppable momentum.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The finals are finally next!
Let's see, I was in Block A, so the person from Block B is—

text_block_list.name: Dying Scream
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAHHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: S-She took on all the runners in Block B at once—and wiped them out in an instant!?!?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... My apologies.
As a lady—perhaps I should have drawn it more elegantly and gently?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
My opponent in the finals is... Gentile-san!?
I'm going head-to-head with you... in power...!?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh my—are you dissatisfied?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding!
I am definitely not losing this match!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the two Umamusume who advanced to the finals!!
Who will claim victory in this match-up!?
It's finally time to start!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Whaaaat!?!?
N-Nggghhhhhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the match that began—
neither yielded an inch, resulting in a timeout
and a restart not once, but twice.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...!
Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I can't deny the fatigue, naturally.
...However... they are—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
……! I don't want to lose……
I won't let myself lose……!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Still... what should I do to make that happen—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Oh my. So this time, you have
your Trainer backing you up, do you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It's strictly just having you stay by my side.
...Is that not okay?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I do not mind. However—
do you truly believe that will be enough to defeat me?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...I just—don't want to have any regrets.
I don't want to lose to myself the same way I did before."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I will do my absolute best to defeat you.
To do that, I must do what I believe is needed most right now.
What is necessary to stay strong.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: That means—having this person by my side.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. It kind of turned into me laying down the gauntlet, but...
I'm counting on you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod and offer as much advice as I can.
The timing when Gentildonna applied the most power
and the subtle quirks in her grip that I noticed while watching.
choice_data_list: Good luck... No, let's do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—as for the outcome of the battle we took on together...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Th-The rope... The custom-made,
extra-durable tug-of-war rope snapped—!!
Ri-Right smack in the middle, too...!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...In other words, this gathering has come to an end, I presume. You certainly prepared a rather boorish rope for the occasion.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I will be looking forward to
our next opportunity with bated breath.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. It was a good match, but—
I didn't get the "win."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Even after borrowing your strength, Trainer...
...I'm still so unreliable, aren't I?
choice_data_list: Being able to rely on others is proof of how dependable you are!
I was happy you relied on me.
Time to make these muscles even stronger...
I need to make these muscles even stronger...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Even after borrowing your strength, Trainer...
...I'm still so unreliable, aren't I?
choice_data_list: Being able to rely on others is proof of how dependable you are!
I was happy you relied on me.
Time to make these muscles even stronger...
I need to make these muscles even stronger...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. I can take this as a step
forward, right?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep moving forward. My heart, my body, my legs.
If it's me...
If it's us, I know we can do it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to hear that.
But you know, the feeling is mutual.
Because—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Because today, I realized just how happy
and reassuring it is to have someone you can rely on.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—That's right. I want to beat her.
Right where she's at her absolute strongest!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
There's no time to be disappointed by
"what I can't do right now." I will reach
any "someday." That is who Almond Eye is!
